item.title: Met Office issues yellow weather warning for Northern Ireland as Storm Bram approaches
item.description: The Met Office has issued a yellow weather warning for Northern Ireland as Storm Bram — officially named by Met Éireann — is forecast to bring severe winds and heavy rain across the UK later on Monday and through Tuesday. The warning is in place from 9:00am to 9:00pm on Tuesday 9 December 2025, with forecasters urging the public to prepare for disruption to travel, power supplies and coastal areas. item.title: Arrest made in long-running investigation into murder of Lisa Dorrian
item.description: Lisa Dorrian Detectives from the Police Service of Northern Ireland’s Major Investigation Team have arrested a 68-year-old man in connection with the murder of 25-year-old Lisa Dorrian, who disappeared nearly two decades ago. Police confirmed the man was detained earlier today, Monday 8 December, on suspicion of murder, assisting offenders, withholding information and preventing a lawful and decent burial.
